steps.input:
program='''def transform(grid):
    """Complete the strongest set of parallel, equally spaced color stripes."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find which family of parallel lines carries the clues: horizontal,
    # down-right (c-r), or down-left (r+c).
    families = [
        (lambda r, c: r),
        (lambda r, c: c-r),
        (lambda r, c: r+c),
    ]
    best = None
    for idx, key_fn in enumerate(families):
        counts = {}
        colors = {}
        for r, c, v in points:
            k = key_fn(r, c)
            counts[k] = counts.get(k, 0) + 1
            colors.setdefault(k, set()).add(v)
        # Maximize concentration on single stripes; ties favor the family
        # whose lines explain the most clue cells.
        score = (max(counts.values()), sum(n*n for n in counts.values()), -idx)
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, key_fn, colors)
    _, key_fn, line_colors = best
    samples = [(k, next(iter(vs))) for k, vs in line_colors.items() if len(vs) == 1]
    maxp = max(h, w) * 2 + 1
    period = next((p for p in range(1, maxp + 1)
                   if all(not any(k2 % p == k % p and col2 != col
                                  for k2, col2 in samples)
                          for k, col in samples)), maxp)
    residue_color = {}
    for k, color in samples:
        residue_color[k % period] = color
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            k = key_fn(r, c)
            row.append(residue_color.get(k % period, 0))
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print(p.read_text())
